# Gemini 3.7 Flash/high Independent Veto Review

**Target Operation:** Reception One selected-appointment cancellation composition  
**Decision Owner:** GPT Sol  
**Reviewer Role:** Exactly one final independent Tier-2 veto after deterministic admission  
**Candidate Worktree:** `C:\Users\sarashera\EMR4-worktrees\reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d`  
**Candidate Branch:** `codex/review-reception-one-cancellation-856ebc3d`  
**Candidate HEAD:** `856ebc3d832d5b64ce65c2e0732eaa63d926c600`  
**Frozen Planning Baseline:** `a6fefda036dc46b964f1f1951d5e2efb48534219`  

---

## 1. Five-Source Mandatory Rehydration

1. **`live_handover_current_baton`:** Verified against [`AGENTS.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d/AGENTS.md) at Continuity 310 / Compass 292. PR 74 integrated, PR 75 merged at protected master `2e34bdad732fdab32fbf778280b3d3c70d66d602`, Pages run `30719055657` passed, and no further GitHub Pages rebuild is authorised.
2. **`current_authority_allocation`:** GPT Sol owns Conductor, architecture, integration, and final acceptance; DeepSeek V4 Flash/high via Claude Code `--bare` owns bounded implementation/test worker packages; Gemini 3.7 Flash/high via Antigravity owns independent Tier-2 read-only veto review. Native subagents remain declined by developer policy.
3. **`active_plan_and_acceptance`:** Governed by [`docs/raisa-reception-one-selected-appointment-cancellation-composition-plan.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d/docs/raisa-reception-one-selected-appointment-cancellation-composition-plan.md), [`docs/security/raisa-reception-one-selected-appointment-cancellation-composition-threat-model-delta.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d/docs/security/raisa-reception-one-selected-appointment-cancellation-composition-threat-model-delta.md), and evidence schema [`selected-appointment-cancellation-composition-evidence.schema.json`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d/orchestration/continuity/raisa-reception-one-selected-appointment-cancellation-composition/selected-appointment-cancellation-composition-evidence.schema.json).
4. **`protected_evidence_boundaries`:** Provider-free authored-synthetic fixtures and route-intercepted browser tests only. No real patient, clinical, historical diary or product data. No live backend/database mutation, no provider calls, no raw `DELETE`, no status fallback, no new backend routes/schemas/migrations. Master and `handoff/current` remain closed and aligned at `2e34bdad732fdab32fbf778280b3d3c70d66d602`. `docs/branding/` and all untracked files are preserved and excluded.
5. **`git_refs_and_worktree`:** Worktree verified at `C:\Users\sarashera\EMR4-worktrees\reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d` on branch `codex/review-reception-one-cancellation-856ebc3d` at commit `856ebc3d832d5b64ce65c2e0732eaa63d926c600`. Active operation latch `orchestration/continuity/ariadne-active-operation-latch/current.json` verified in progress.

---

## 2. Evaluation of Required Challenges

### Challenge 1: Worktree, Ref, Baseline, and Exact Diff Integrity
- Exact branch `codex/review-reception-one-cancellation-856ebc3d` and HEAD `856ebc3d832d5b64ce65c2e0732eaa63d926c600` verified via C01, C02, and C09.
- The worktree is completely clean with zero untracked or dirty files.
- The diff `a6fefda036dc46b964f1f1951d5e2efb48534219..856ebc3d832d5b64ce65c2e0732eaa63d926c600` touches only allowlisted paths across 12 files (3 HTML/JS/CSS assets in `docs/diary/`, 1 plan, 4 orchestration/continuity artifacts, 2 review tests, and 2 test updates). No unauthorized files were created or modified.

### Challenge 2: Native Palette, Shared Editor, and Distinct Danger Treatment
- The selected action palette in [`docs/diary/meta-grid.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d/docs/diary/meta-grid.js#L4438-L4460) contains exactly five choices: `status`, `time`, `duration`, `practitioner`, and `cancel`.
- Cancellation is styled with distinct danger tokens (`meta-grid-action-choice-danger`, terracotta/red palette `#c28e7d`, `#7b2c22`, `#fff1eb`, `#9f4939`).
- At most one editor panel mounts inside `#meta-grid-selected-action-editor` at any given time.
- Retains the four existing update families without creating a generic or unvalidated write dispatcher.

### Challenge 3: Route-Inert Drafting, Reason Vocabulary, and Note Constraint
- Opening, closing, switching, or drafting in the cancellation panel issues zero HTTP routes (verified by `test_cancellation_palette_and_draft_are_route_inert`).
- Reason options in [`docs/diary/diary.js`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/reception-one-cancellation-gemini-review-856ebc3d/docs/diary/diary.js) are restricted to exactly the 10 dedicated codes: `PATIENT_CANCELLED`, `PATIENT_RESCHEDULED`, `PATIENT_UNWELL`, `PATIENT_TRANSPORT`, `PRACTITIONER_UNAVAILABLE`, `CLINIC_OPERATIONAL`, `CLINIC_RESCHEDULED`, `ADMIN_ERROR`, `DUPLICATE_BOOKING`, and `OTHER`.
- Optional cancellation note is validated and capped at 500 characters, trimmed, and treated as provisional input.

### Challenge 4: Dedicated Proposal and Canonical Confirm Routes with Visible Human Confirmation
- `EMR4DiaryMetaGridBridge.cancelAppointment` submits proposal exclusively to `POST /api/v1/appointments/proposals/delete/{appointment_id}`.
- Every admissible proposal triggers explicit visible staff confirmation through `showStatusProposalDialog`.
- Confirmed submission uses only canonical `POST /api/v1/appointments/proposals/delete/confirm` with cloned prepared payload and `confirmed=true`.

### Challenge 5: Blocked Proposals, Close-Only Dialog, and Escape Handling
- Blocked proposals (`autonomy_tier === "blocked"`) render a close-only dialog without a confirm action.
- Pressing Escape or clicking Cancel sends zero confirm requests, retains current Diary truth, and returns focus.
- Busy state latches (`anySelectedActionBusy()`, `state.cancellationAction.busy`) prevent double submission, palette switching, or selection races during in-flight operations.

### Challenge 6: Strict Fail-Closed Envelope and Minimal Public Receipt
- Responses are strictly validated via `validateDeleteConfirmPublicEnvelope` against `raisa.delete_confirm_public_envelope.v1` and `appointment.delete_confirmation_receipt.v1`.
- Requires exact matching `appointment_id` and `status_reason_code`, `status="Cancelled"`, `waiting_area_id=null`, and allowed warning code `waiting_area_cleared`.
- Rejects unknown top-level/receipt fields, unexpected audit evidence, private receipt bytes, or any returned `appointment` read-model object.

### Challenge 7: Robust Handling of Stale, Mismatched, and Malformed Responses
- Stale proposals, server/network errors, mismatched IDs/reasons, non-null waiting areas, and unexpected warning codes fail closed without creating fallbacks or optimistic state mutations.
- The UI triggers fresh reconciliation via `refreshCurrent(...)` on any uncertain or failed outcome.

### Challenge 8: Post-Command Truth Display and Scoped Reconciliation
- The appointment is removed from view only after a fresh authorized list read confirms its absence.
- If reconciliation read fails, the console transitions to `reconciliation_required` state, disabling all selected action controls and presenting the refresh action.

### Challenge 9: Accessibility, Responsive Layout, and Viewport Containment
- Touch targets meet or exceed the 44px minimum requirement across all controls.
- Keyboard navigation (Tab loops, Escape to close, focus return) functions correctly.
- Polite atomic live region (`aria-live="polite"`, `aria-atomic="true"`) announces outcome states.
- Responsive styles tested and verified across desktop (1280x720), tablet (768x1024), and mobile (390x844) without horizontal document/editor overflow.

### Challenge 10: Backend and Governance Invariants
- GraphQL remains read-only; no backend routes, schemas, tables, migrations, or event watchers were added.
- No live provider/model calls, external network traffic, or product/patient data touched.
- No deployment, publication, or protected ref modification occurred.

### Challenge 11: Command Manifest Verification
- All 9 commands in the bound manifest were executed in strict sequential order.
- Manifest exit codes: C01=0, C02=0, C03=0 (84/84 passed), C04=0 (43/43 passed), C05=0, C06=0, C07=0, C08=0, C09=0.
- Worktree and HEAD remain clean and unchanged.

---

## 3. Review Conclusion

The candidate at `856ebc3d832d5b64ce65c2e0732eaa63d926c600` safely and cleanly implements the fifth `Cancel appointment` action for Reception One over the canonical delete proposal/confirm protocol. All security controls, strict envelope boundaries, human confirmation stops, accessibility constraints, and deterministic test gates pass without defect.

Independent Tier-2 veto decision: **pass**.
